pickup_datetime.description: Timestamp when the meter was engaged

pickup_longitude.description: Longitude where the meter was engaged

pickup_latitude.description: Latitude where the meter was engaged

store_and_fwd_flag.description: Trip held in vehicle memory before sending (Y/N)

dropoff_datetime.description: Timestamp when the meter was disengaged
dropoff_datetime.warning: Only known after trip ends. Used ONLY to derive the target. MUST NOT be a model feature.

trip_duration.description: Raw trip duration in seconds from the dataset
trip_duration.warning: This IS the target variable. MUST NOT be used as a model input feature.
